title: EGiME: Entropy-Guided Model Evaluation in Few-Shot Learning
abstract: arXiv:2610.27029v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: The feature-extraction quality of pre-trained models sets the ceiling of downstream transfer learning, yet few-shot model selection remains difficult: supervised evaluation on scarce labels is unstable and yields fluctuating rankings. We propose Entropy-Guided Model Evaluation (EGiME), a semi-supervised criterion that assesses a candidate model from the clustering structure of its feature space without any classifier training. EGiME performs $K$-means clustering over all labeled and unlabeled samples, then combines two entropy terms: an inter-cluster entropy measuring global separability, and an intra-cluster entropy measuring the compactness of labeled anchors, fused through an inverse-frequency weight that emphasizes small clusters. On five few-shot benchmarks and nine pre-trained models, EGiME achieves a correlation score of 0.966 with the full-pool ground-truth accuracy obtained by averaging the accuracies of K-means, KNN, and SVM. translated_title: EGiME：小样本学习中的熵引导模型评估
translated_abstract: 预训练模型的特征提取质量决定了下游迁移学习的上限，然而小样本模型选择仍然困难：基于稀缺标签的监督式评估不稳定，且排名容易波动。我们提出了熵引导模型评估（EGiME），这是一种半监督准则，无需训练任何分类器，即可从候选模型特征空间的聚类结构出发对其进行评估。EGiME 对所有有标签和无标签样本执行 K-means 聚类，然后结合两个熵项：衡量全局可分性的簇间熵，以及衡量有标签锚点紧凑性的簇内熵，二者通过强调小簇的逆频率权重进行融合。在五个小样本基准和九个预训练模型上，EGiME 与通过平均 K-means、KNN 和 SVM 准确率获得的全池真值准确率之间的相关性得分达到 0.966。
tldr: 提出了一种无需训练分类器的半监督评估准则EGiME，通过逆频率权重融合簇间熵与簇内熵来衡量预训练模型特征空间的聚类结构，在五个小样本基准上与真值准确率达到0.966的相关性。
en_tdlr: EGiME is a classifier-free semi-supervised model evaluation criterion that fuses inter-cluster and intra-cluster entropy with inverse-frequency weighting to assess feature-space clustering structure, achieving a 0.966 correlation with ground-truth accuracy across five few-shot benchmarks.
